requirements_summary: Workload mix: 60% short-turn chat (avg 90 tokens response), 30% embeddings for search (1k tokens per call), 10% long-form summarization (avg 600 tokens)
Latency targets: conversational routes target P50 < 120ms, P95 < 400ms; embeddings P95 < 600ms
Throughput expectation: daytime peak 18 QPS, sustained 6 QPS; concurrency target ~40 concurrent streams during feature launches
Cost goals: unit cost target <$0.0009 per token (weighted), seek batching/cache suggestions
Security: VPC-private control plane, CMEK/KMS for model keys, SSO (SAML), audit logs retained 90d
Routing: prefer regional routing (US primary, EU fallback) and automatic fallback to smaller model variants
hosted_api_trial_metrics: Total tokens consumed: ~2.4M tokens across routes
Avg tokens per chat session: request 28, response 92
Observed latencies: P50 110ms, P95 340ms on hosted for chat; embeddings avg 420ms
Error rate: 0.6% (mostly 429s during sudden spikes), transient 500s < 0.1%
Peak observed QPS during trial: 12 QPS (short load tests), concurrency observed up to 28 streams
Cache hit signal: prefix caching reduced token generation by ~18% on repeat flows
Notes: trial used standard hosted model variant; cost ran ~ $3.2k/month during trial for limited traffic
dedicated_sizing_forecast: Target capacity: sustain 6 QPS steady state, absorb 18 QPS peak with 2x headroom for flash events
Estimated concurrency sizing: target 40 streams to keep tail latency inside SLOs
Token mix estimate: 70% short chat (<200 tokens), 20% embeddings (1k tokens), 10% long-form (>500 tokens)
Recommended Dedicated config: initial cluster for evaluation: 2 dedicated inference nodes (each equivalent to 80GB GPU slot) with autoscale burst policy to add 1 node under sustained queueing
Fallback plan: capacity-based routing to smaller quantized model when queue > threshold to protect P95 latency
Projected monthly token volume for first 12 months: 60M tokens -> estimated monthly billing baseline used for ARR calc
POC milestone: 2-week Dedicated pilot (staging) + performance validation with in-band traffic; finalize pricing after pilot
Notes: SE recommends enabling KV prefix caching + batch size tuning (suggested batch window 25ms) to reduce per-token cost
